FAQ Partner login Book a demo call
✓

You're booked. Let's make this call count.

Your demo call is on the calendar. Take 5 minutes to go through the steps below. Partners who prepare get far more out of the call.

  1. 1

    Confirm it on your calendar

    Check your inbox for the confirmation email and add the call to your calendar. Don't see it? Check your spam or promotions folder.

  2. 2

    Make a quick list

    Jot down 5 to 10 business owners you know. We'll use it on the call to show you exactly where the opportunities are.

    • Clients, customers or friends who own a business
    • Anyone who's mentioned cash flow, equipment, hiring or expansion
    • Anyone a bank recently turned down
  3. 3

    Show up ready

    Join from a computer in a quiet spot so you can see the platform on screen. Think about your goal: extra income on the side, or building a real second income stream?

Can't make it? Use the reschedule link in your confirmation email so your spot goes to someone on the waitlist.
